declaration.evidence_label: E-MAX DEVELOPMENT (reused development data; not OOS)
declaration.question: Which of the M0 global exposure multipliers 1.0x / 1.5x / 2.0x, applied on top of R1 + max 3 + B2 + X1, gives the highest compound growth inside the frozen risk envelope?
declaration.interpretation: M5 tests how much risk to put on the existing E-MAX edge; a lower p-value from scaling is not new Alpha evidence

e_base_reference.source: E-R3 result via M1 R0 (CAGR 3.71%, cumulative +7.19%, MDD -16.45%)

dataset.binding: the E-R2 .. M4 development binding, unchanged (480 sessions 2024-10-16..2026-09-16)
dataset.prechecks: re-run through app.backtest.strategy_e_max.prepare before any return

configuration: R1 ordering + max 3 + B2 breadth exposure + X1 (exact 09:30 open -> exact 09:34 close), the M4 carried configuration

variants.composition: final session exposure = global multiplier x B2 breadth multiplier; B2 is neither removed nor replaced
variants.weights: equal weight over executable positions, scaled: e.g. E20 normal 3 positions 2/3 each; E20 high-breadth 3 positions 1 each; E15 high-breadth 2 positions 9/8 each
variants.implementation: app.strategy_e_max.exposure.apply_global on the X1 sessions of app.backtest.strategy_e_max.m4_replay
forbidden: changes to R1, capacity, B2, entry, exit or cost
clipping or flooring of session losses

accounting.cost_scaling: levered net = exposure x (gross - round-trip cost); the net scenario return of each position is multiplied, never gross x leverage minus one cost
accounting.compounding: equity_t = equity_(t-1) x (1 + session_return_t) over all 480 sessions (E-D6 equity_stats); MDD recomputed from the levered compounded series, never Base MDD x multiplier
accounting.catastrophic_rule: a candidate with any COST_10BP session return <= -100% (equity <= 0) is ineligible (CATASTROPHIC_SESSION_LOSS); no clipping
accounting.concentration: computed on levered PnL (normalized weight x trade return); a global scalar leaves shares unchanged relative to E1, B2 already makes session exposure non-uniform

financing.BROKER_LEVERAGE_FEASIBILITY: NOT VALIDATED (leverage rules, buying power, forced liquidation)
financing.status: research only; E20 high-breadth total exposure 3.0x is not a live authorization; Common Risk V1 has no leverage

e1_reproduction: E1 must hash to the committed M4 X1 artifacts (trades and daily returns) before E15 / E20 are read
invariants: identical universe, H5, R1 order, selection, entries, exits and prices for E1 / E15 / E20
E15 and E20 session returns are exactly 1.5x and 2.0x E1 in every scenario

eligibility.source: M0 selection_rule.eligibility, verbatim values, plus the catastrophic rule above

improvement.comparator: E1 for each candidate separately (no hierarchy between E15 and E20; M0 defines none)
improvement.paired: delta_t = candidate - E1 COST_10BP session return, all 480 sessions; metrics.bootstrap_mean_ci, IID, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260921
improvement.scaling_caveat: delta_t = (k - 1) x E1_t, so P(delta <= 0) equals the bootstrap probability that E1's mean is <= 0; it measures the E1 edge, not an exposure effect

winner.rule: among E15 / E20 passing every eligibility and improvement condition, the highest COST_10BP CAGR; exact ties by higher session mean, then declared order; none -> NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT and E1 is kept

m6_authorization.rule: M6 is AUTHORIZED when the configuration carried out of M5 passes every M0 eligibility condition (and the catastrophic rule) and stop conditions A and D do not hold; stop B is reported and becomes decisive only at M6
m6_authorization.stop_d: every candidate of two consecutive executed stages below -35% MDD

diagnostics.stop_b: reported twice: vs the stage comparator E1 (the M2-M4 convention) and vs E-Base (M0 literal): flagged when |MDD| ratio > CAGR ratio
breadth_interaction: MDD window (peak to trough) contribution by class
tail: top1 / top3 / top5 session share of the summed session returns
diagnostics.blocks: E-D6 four blocks: mean, compounded return, block MDD, positive block count
calendar: positive / negative months, best / worst month
positive / negative quarters, best / worst quarter

reproducibility.required: identical result digest and byte-identical runtime artifacts
